point: stay + 持續的狀態：用 until，不用 by。
why: The verb is must stay parked: a state that lasts, not an action finished once. It lasts until the repair is done (when the contractor expects to finish), so the word is until.
動詞是 must stay parked：這是持續的狀態，不是做一次就完成的動作。狀態持續到維修完成（when the contractor expects to finish）為止，所以用 until。

gloss.ex: The ship docked at the quay at dawn.
The crane lowered its boom slowly.
The contractor finished the roof early.
Each brake assembly is tested twice.

point: within + 一段時間 + of + 起算事件。
why: Far from the blank, of receiving it shows the pattern within seven days of …: seven days counted from receipt. The clause or the carrier may reject confirms it is a limit: within.
離空格很遠的 of receiving it 顯示句型 within seven days of …：從收到起算七天。or the carrier may reject 也說明這是期限：within。

gloss.ex: Customers may lodge a complaint online.
The price excludes shipping costs.
The carrier delivered the crate on Monday.
The office closes on public holidays.

point: at the end of: exactly at that point.
at the end of：正好在那個時間點。
why: once the last late transactions have been posted at midnight on the final day means the work waits for the very end of the month: at. since needs a perfect tense, not reconciles.
once the last late transactions have been posted at midnight on the final day 表示要等到月底最後一刻：at。since 要配完成式，不能接 reconciles。

gloss.ex: Accountants reconcile the ledger every Friday.
Bank statements arrive by email.
Every transaction is logged automatically.

why: a stretch of nine weeks is a length of time that has ended, and the verb is past tense (ran). So for. since and from give a starting point, not a length.
a stretch of nine weeks 是已結束的時間長度，動詞又是過去式 ran。所以用 for。since 與 from 給的是起點，不是長度。

gloss.ex: Each recorded fault is reviewed on Monday.
The stabilization period lasts six weeks.
Leaves clogged the drain overnight.
Staff clean the intake screen weekly.

point: run ahead of a forecast: better than predicted.
run ahead of 預測：比預測更好。
why: The forecast assumed that sales would be slow, yet the factory must add a second shift. Orders beat the forecast: ahead of. in line with would mean slow orders too.
預測 assumed that sales would be slow，yet 工廠卻要 add a second shift。訂單超過預測：ahead of。in line with 會代表訂單也慢。

gloss.ex: The sales forecast was revised in May.
Workers on the second shift start at two.
We hired staff to keep up with orders.

point: prior to + Ving：在……之前。to 是介系詞。
why: while the part is still in its packaging shows the number is logged before the part is fitted: prior to installing. subsequent to means after, which that clause rules out.
while the part is still in its packaging 顯示序號在零件裝上之前登記：prior to installing。subsequent to 表示之後，被該子句排除。

gloss.ex: Enter the serial number on the form.
The replacement part arrives on Tuesday.
Use only items on the approved parts list.
Keep the original packaging for returns.

point: in response to + an event that came earlier.
in response to + 較早發生的事。
why: which had begun the previous Monday puts the outage before the Friday cut, and the refinery reacted to it: in response to. in anticipation of needs an event still to come.
which had begun the previous Monday 把停電放在星期五減產之前，煉油廠是對它作出反應：in response to。in anticipation of 要接尚未發生的事。

gloss.ex: The refinery processes oil from three fields.
The outage lasted about two hours.
The regulator approved the new tariff.

why: ever since the supplier's plant was shut by a strike and the order is now due to ship from the Bexley depot both show there is no stock here. The phrase is out of stock.
ever since the supplier's plant was shut by a strike 與 the order is now due to ship from the Bexley depot 都顯示這裡沒有貨。片語是 out of stock。

gloss.ex: We stock several valve fittings.
The plant was shut for repairs.
Orders ship within two working days.

point: as of + a date: from that day on.
as of + 日期：自該日起。
why: whereas claims filed earlier will still be paid at the old rate shows the new rate starts on that date. That is as of. by and before would include the earlier claims.
whereas claims filed earlier will still be paid at the old rate 顯示新費率從那天才開始。這是 as of。by 與 before 會把較早的申請也算進來。

gloss.ex: Mileage claims need a signed log.
Meals will be reimbursed within two weeks.
She filed the claim on Monday.

why: the inspector says he cannot complete before the end of March means the outcome does not exist yet. The permit is suspended while waiting for it: pending. following and after need a known outcome.
the inspector says he cannot complete before the end of March 表示結果還不存在。許可證在等待期間被暫停：pending。following 與 after 要有已知的結果。

gloss.ex: The operating permit expires in June.
The airline suspended flights for a day.
The inspector visits each site yearly.

why: from the check-in hall to the farthest boarding gate shows the signs cover every part of the terminal. That meaning is throughout. through means passing through.
from the check-in hall to the farthest boarding gate 顯示標示涵蓋航廈每一處。這個意思是 throughout。through 表示穿過。

gloss.ex: Clear wayfinding signs reduce lost visitors.
The check-in hall opens at four.
Gate 12 is the boarding gate for Oslo.

why: he has asked to hand it over to a successor shows he holds the responsibility now. A duty can be handed over; a view cannot. The phrase is in charge of.
he has asked to hand it over to a successor 顯示他現在擔負這項職責。職責可以交接，立場不行。片語是 in charge of。

gloss.ex: The deputy director signed the form.
The briefing starts at nine.
The pilot scheme runs for six months.
She trained her successor carefully.
